description: Read the existing hook ownership challenge and verification or revocation status using its management token. No activation or delivery. Use after registration or an interrupted verification; use get_hook_delivery for one accepted event.

hookId.description: Hook identifier returned by registration; preserve for all subsequent operations.

managementToken.description: Private management token returned by registration. Required for status, activation, revocation and credits; not the delivery token.

name: get_destination_status
title: Get Destination Status
